Baked horizon-angle ambient occlusion (photoreal-drone #5) multiplying the AMBIENT term only, never direct — the ONE added effect that makes terrain MORE legible (deepens draw-bottoms, cliff bases, terrace insides where the dead ground is). Reuses the existing cast-shadow march, omnidirectional.

Living-valley's foam-at-fords insight: animated whitewater that blooms and advects exactly at fords/steep channel makes the CROSSING read MORE obvious — a rare case where a cinematic effect strengthens the tactical instrument. Graft into any water plan.

Keep the `formLightNW` noon guard verbatim (shaders.ts:138-142, max(keySun,keyNW) blended at 0.32) AND extend it to lit sprites (asset-fidelity) — it is the confirmed load-bearing relief-inversion guard and every micro-normal/detail effect must be slaved to the SAME light direction it picks at noon, or micro and macro shading disagree.

cinematic-film's HDR-linear + ACES tonemap foundation — the right transformation regardless of which proposal wins; attempt-1's raw clamped linear is why golden hour clipped flat. Adopt the linear pipeline + Narkowicz ACES as the shared render foundation, but pair it with the compound-veil floor gate below.

Weather-as-luminance-material (living-valley) over weather-as-volumetric-veil (cinematic-film): wetness/snow as palette-bound luminance shifts can't bury the read the way raymarched fog can. Prefer material-state weather; treat any volumetric fog as the constrained exception with a hard compound-floor gate.
legibilityTraps: THE NOON TRAP (hits photoreal-drone and cinematic-film hardest): the real sun at noon is due south and near-vertical (sun-probe: ~(0,0.24,0.97)), so any 'low-sun-rakes-micro-normals' photoreal trigger is physically DEAD at noon AND the formLightNW guard lights the macro relief with a FAKED NW key — so micro-normals lit by the real south sun disagree with macro relief lit by the fake NW key, reading as noise over the map. Every detail-normal effect MUST be slaved to the same faked-NW direction the guard picks at noon, and gated near-zero there. This is the single most-cited risk and it lands at the legibility-critical band-agnostic time.

THE COMPOUND-VEIL FLOOR (cinematic-film): the reference fog-dawn-operational.png is ALREADY at the legibility floor. Aerial-perspective inscatter + raymarched fog inscatter + bloom on lit fog COMPOUND, and three independent caps (≤0.55 each) do not bound their SUM. The river draw — the most tactically important ground — is exactly where fog pools. Requires ONE numeric floor gate on the summed veil, measured against the existing fog frame.

SCREEN-SPACE LIGHT SHAFTS / GOD-RAYS (cinematic-film 5b): a radial-blur pass that fans bright streaks ACROSS the frame over readable terrain is the textbook way to bury a tactical read under a glow, and requires faking an on-screen anchor for a below-horizon sun. The geometrically-honest in-fog shafts (5a) are the safe version; the screen-space pass should be opt-in behind a review gate, never default.

ROTATING-SPRITE LIGHT SPIN (asset-fidelity and cinematic-film's sprite relight): lit soldiers/vehicles must have their normals rotated into WORLD frame AFTER heading-rotation, or the lighting spins with the sprite — the classic bug. A screen-space gradient relight (cinematic-film) CANNOT satisfy this; only a true per-instance world-frame normal does. Turntable probe is the gate.

WORLD-MOTION vs TACTICAL-MOTION ATTENTION COMPETITION (living-valley): swaying canopy/grass and a churning river compete for the eye against the things that SHOULD move — units, fire, threat cues on the 2D layer. Subtle motion is fine; motion loud enough to pull the eye off a moving contact is a command-read failure. Gate world-motion off at operational/strategic and budget its amplitude below the tactical-motion attention threshold.

SNOW / WET-FILL WASHING THE CREST SILHOUETTE (living-valley snow cold-bounce, photoreal-drone snow): snow that fills shadow with cold ambient bounce flattens the ridgeline relief the player ranges and reads LOS off. Snow albedo on skyline/LOS-relevant ridge cells must be capped so the silhouette and form survive; cold-fill must never raise a shadowed crest face above its lit face.

SURFACE-FEATURE CONFUSION (photoreal-drone furrow normals): high-frequency directional textures (cropland furrows along the contour) at tactical zoom can be mistaken for real tactical features the player must read — a defilade line, a wall, a wadi. Cap amplitude and forbid alignments that mimic man-made/terrain features; probe furrowed cropland adjacent to a real wadi.

TRANSIENT WATER MISTAKEN FOR PERMANENT (living-valley rain pooling): routing low-lying cells through the water BRDF during rain paints reflective water onto normally-readable terrain (and the draw is often the approach route). A transient pool must be visually distinct from the river/fords and must never cover a route cell.

BRIGHT MOVING HIGHLIGHTS ON ROUTES (photoreal-drone water glint / wet sheen, asset-fidelity vehicle specular): any tracking specular highlight that lands on a road/trail/ford/crossing — the ground the player reads movement tactics off — is glare that degrades the route read. Hard-clamp so no specular ever lands on a route cell at any sun angle.
feasibilityTraps: RGBA16F renderability under headless SwiftShader is the load-bearing assumption for cinematic-film's ENTIRE HDR foundation and for the bloom in living-valley/asset-fidelity. If the half-float color attachment isn't renderable in software, the whole pipeline shape needs the RGBA8 packed-exposure fallback. Must be probed at init with a branch, exactly as the recovered skeleton branches for the 2D fallback — and the screenshot harness (the strict SwiftShader consumer) must be proven on the fallback path.

Per-frame raymarch cost on SwiftShader (cinematic-film's 6-8 step fog march + the god-ray radial blur) is the heaviest per-frame item in the set on a SOFTWARE rasterizer. The screenshot harness runs under SwiftShader; an 8-tap-per-fragment march at screen res may blow the harness budget. Step-count must LOD with zoom and early-out aggressively, and the honest cost must be measured on SwiftShader-headless, not asserted.

photoreal-drone and asset-fidelity both depend on a multi-megabyte atlas (2048² PBR material atlas / 4096² GBuffer atlas). photoreal-drone's claim that the material atlas is generated DETERMINISTICALLY at load (no shipped PNGs, seed contract holds) is the right call; asset-fidelity's build-time GBuffer bake adds a generated artifact that must obey the 'edit sources, regenerate' invariant (extend build-asset-manifest.mjs). Atlas seam-bleed (manual per-tile clamping, no hardware wrap) is a real correctness trap both must handle.

R8UI integer textures (photoreal-drone's land-ID spine) need the correct usampler2D path — within WebGL2 core but must be unit-tested for texelFetch parity against terrain.land, same discipline as the heightAt parity test, or the material LUT silently mis-keys.

New persisted surface state (living-valley's wetness/snow floats; photoreal-drone's surfaceState texture if persisted) MUST go in BOTH serialize() AND loadWorld() or determinism/save round-trip breaks — a named invariant. The smoke test (serialize round-trip) is the gate.

asset-fidelity's SDF-extrude-from-silhouette baseline for 164 assets is the riskiest feasibility bet of that proposal: if it yields mushy 'puffed-pillow' normals, only the ~20 hand-authored heroes look transformed and the cheap-volume promise collapses. The fallback (hero-only height layers + cast-shadow grounding for the long tail) is sound but means the '10x ALL assets' claim narrows to '10x the heroes.'

All four reuse the cast-shadow march but only on sun-MOTION rebake (throttled, a few Hz). cinematic-film adds two MORE consumers (fog raymarch per-step sampling, god-ray mask) that read it per-frame — fine since it's a resident texture, but the rebake cadence vs time-warp must keep the shadow current without per-frame rebake cost; the recovered code throttles by sun-angle delta, which must be preserved.
verdicts.recommendedSpine: "Spine = photoreal-drone, for legibility reasons specifically. It is the only proposal whose transformation is engineered to COLLAPSE toward the proven legible read by construction (single ppm-gate to byte-faithful strategic, numeric noon-luma calibration), it puts its energy on the VALLEY (the brief's actual target — a drone feed is OF the ground), and its one form-REVEALING effect (HBAO on the ambient term) is the rare addition that makes terrain MORE readable. It honestly names the noon micro-normal trap as its riskiest bet and degrades gracefully (linear lighting + world-scale material albedo + AO already beat attempt-1 even if normals are cut entirely), so the 10x is not all-or-nothing on the hostile-to-legibility technique. Graft onto it: (1) cinematic-film's HDR-linear+ACES foundation as the shared render base (photoreal-drone already assumes linear-space lighting — adopt the explicit ACES pass and the RGBA16F-with-RGBA8-fallback probe). (2) asset-fidelity's deferred lit-sprite pass + continuous-HESCO berm + contact-AO grounding as the ASSET track, since photoreal-drone leaves the 164 sprites untouched and the brief says 'ALL visuals' — but slave sprite lighting to the SAME SkyState and the SAME formLightNW guard, with world-frame normal rotation verified by turntable. (3) living-valley's foam-at-fords and clock-driven flow into photoreal-drone's specular-water technique (the foam strengthens the crossing read). EXCLUDE by default from the spine: cinematic-film's screen-space god-ray pass (5b), chromatic aberration, vignette above operational, and any raymarched volumetric fog that isn't bounded by a single compound-veil floor gate measured against fog-dawn-operational.png — these are the effects that fight the symbology, and the brief's one sacred guardrail is legibility. Net: photoreal-drone's valley + asset-fidelity's assets + living-valley's water-motion + cinematic-film's tonemap, with cinematic-film's atmosphere ambitions admitted only behind hard numeric legibility floors."

perProposal.strengths: This is the proposal that most directly inverts the parity sin and proves it understands WHY attempt-1 failed. The single load-bearing insight is correct: on a top-down ortho camera there is no parallax or silhouette, so the entire photographed-vs-painted read MUST be carried by light acting on real per-material micro-normals — and attempt-1 had literally zero surface normals (its only 'detail' was a `col *= 1 + grain*detailA` brightness multiply at shaders.ts:182-186, which I confirmed is paint, not relief). Detail-normal raking (technique 3) is the actual 10x trigger and is identified as such with eyes open. The albedo bake is correctly DEMOTED from 'the image' to one of five inputs — this is the exact opposite of `col = albedo*(0.34+0.95*shade)`. Real HBAO (technique 5) replaces the fake `sky=0.5+0.5*n.z` term (shaders.ts:146) with a true horizon-march occlusion field reusing the already-proven shadow march code — high-leverage and cheap (one-time bake). The material-ID data spine (R8UI/usampler2D, RGBA8 control, small surfaceState) is format-disciplined and SwiftShader-safe (no RGBA16F dependency — it tonemaps in the existing pass, the one real risk the cinematic proposals take that this one sidesteps). Procedural-bake-at-load atlas (no shipped PNGs) preserves the seed contract and asset pipeline. The phase plan is the best in the set: Phase 1 (linear lighting, no new textures, numeric noon-luma calibration) ships a strict improvement before any risk lands, and the absolute-floor argument (Phases 1+3 alone beat attempt-1 because the ground stops being one upscaled bitmap) means the 10x is NOT all-or-nothing on the riskiest technique.
perProposal.fatalFlaws: No fatal flaw, but two real soft spots. (1) The honest riskiest-bet — detail-normals on a top-down ortho camera flatten toward 'painted' at NOON exactly when sun rake-angle → 0, which is also the legibility-inversion case. The mitigation (detailStrength scales with rake-angle so noon leans on albedo+AO+roughness) is sound but means the marquee photoreal surface read is a DAWN/DUSK phenomenon; midday close-zoom degrades to 'a very good textured orthophoto,' not 'an ISR feed.' That is still a genuine 10x but the holy-shit moment is time-of-day-gated. (2) SwiftShader cost: 2-3 atlas taps + 1-2 normal taps per fragment at close zoom stacked on the existing ~14 texelFetches is the honest worry; 3-6ms estimate on SwiftShader is plausible but the headless harness is the hard gate and could force the single-channel-detail-height fallback. The bloom pass (separable blur, 2-3ms) is correctly the first cut. Neither flaw is fatal because both have graceful degradation that still clears the bar.
mustFix: Pin the noon close-zoom fallback as a FIRST-CLASS look, not a degradation: when rake-angle→0, drive micro-contrast from roughness + AO + albedo-variation so the surface still reads as material at midday — verify with the noon-close matrix frame before declaring Phase 3 done (this is the exact frame attempt-1 smeared).

Gate the entire detail-normal + second-octave atlas strength by ppm AND prove on the SwiftShader headless harness that close-zoom stays inside the per-frame budget BEFORE Phase 3 ships; pre-implement the single-tap detail-height fallback behind a flag, do not merely describe it.

Keep the linear-space calibration as a NUMERIC gate (mid-gray noon-clear luma matches the recovered frame) not a vibe — this is the one parity anchor that prevents relief inversion, and it must survive every later phase, re-checked in the matrix.

perProposal.strengths: The most ambitious MOOD transformation and the only proposal whose marquee is a genuinely new IMAGE attempt-1 never even attempted: geometrically-true volumetric god-rays sampled from the SAME cast-shadow map the relief uses (technique 5a), so shafts rake from the real ridge that throws them. That is a real leap, not a filter. Moving the renderer to linear HDR + real ACES (technique 1) is the correct foundational diagnosis — attempt-1 wrote raw clamped linear (`shade*0.94+0.02` then a fillRect tint) which is exactly why it looked like gouache. Converting atmosphere from `mix(col,fogColor,t)` paint to single-scattering aerial perspective + a 6-8 step fog raymarch with per-step cast-shadow in-scatter (techniques 3-4) is real light transport, and the orthographic-column transmittance approximation is physically defensible (the eye reads relative haze-by-altitude). The fog raymarch reusing the recovered floor-field min-field is correct and proven. Crucially, the proposal has the best-articulated FALLBACK ladder of the four: cut 5b (screen-space) keep 5a (in-fog shafts), and RGBA8 packed-exposure if RGBA16F isn't renderable — so the spine survives its own riskiest bets.
perProposal.fatalFlaws: Two real concerns keep this below the photoreal proposal. (1) FOUNDATION RISK: the entire pipeline assumes RGBA16F is renderable under headless SwiftShader — and the recovered, PROVEN stack uses NO float color attachment (RGBA8 main, R8 shadow, R32F-NEAREST height). This is an UNPROVEN assumption at the base of the stack; the RGBA8 packed-exposure fallback keeps the shape but loses the highlight range that the whole 'highlights breathe / snow blooms' thesis depends on, so a SwiftShader miss quietly guts the marquee. (2) It is light-and-air biased and comparatively THIN on the GROUND itself — the literal '10x more realistic' reading is the resolvable surface, and this proposal's close-zoom material/micro-normal work (technique 12) is one bullet near the end of the stack, weaker than photoreal-drone's centerpiece. God-rays are spectacular at blue-hour but vanish at noon (correctly), so at midday this risks reverting toward 'attempt-1 with a better tonemap' — the cinematic lift is heavily time-of-day-gated. The proposal's own riskiest-bet admits 5b is the most likely thing to read as a cheesy lens-flare game effect.
mustFix: Probe RGBA16F renderability under the ACTUAL --disable-gpu SwiftShader harness in Phase 0 and commit the RGBA8 packed-exposure path as the DEFAULT if it fails — do not let the marquee depend on an unverified extension; the whole 'breathe/bloom' thesis must survive 8-bit.

Strengthen the GROUND: pull close-zoom detail-normal materials forward (it is the literal reading of 'realistic' and the noon-legible read), so midday close zoom is not just 'attempt-1 + ACES.' Borrow photoreal-drone's per-material micro-normal as the centerpiece, not an afterthought.

Treat 5b (screen-space god-rays) as cut-by-default: ship 5a (in-fog shafts, geometrically honest) first, only add 5b if the screenshot review proves it reads as documentary not lens-flare — the faked on-screen sun-anchor for a below-horizon sun is the exact gimmick tell.

perProposal.strengths: The sharpest single thesis in the set: photoreal aerial truth on a top-down COIN map comes from MOTION and WATER — the two things a real drone feed has that a painted bitmap can never fake. This is a genuinely different and correct attack vector. The flow-advected animated river (technique 1) — a baked RG8 flow field from centerX gradient, two-octave Vlachos flowmap scroll, fresnel sky-reflection, depth tint, clock-keyed so pause stills the water — is a real category change from attempt-1's dead blue ribbon with a sine ripple, and no tactical top-down map ships shaded moving water, so the 'holy shit' is legitimately novel. Whitewater foam at fords (technique 2) is the standout legibility WIN of all four proposals: it makes the SOP crossing MORE obvious while being beautiful — the rare effect that serves both masters. The 'pause and the water freezes mid-glint' moment is the most emotionally resonant holy-shit framing because it ties the visual directly to the game's soul (the ONE master clock). Weather-as-ground-state (wetness/snow accumulators integrated off the sim clock, persisted in serialize/loadWorld) is the only proposal that makes the valley REMEMBER its weather, and correctly flags the new-persisted-float invariant.
perProposal.fatalFlaws: Two weaknesses. (1) It is comparatively WEAKER on the dominant-surface-area problem: most of the screen at every band is SLOPE, not river or canopy. The river is a tiny fraction of pixels; the canopy material (technique 3) is solid but the bulk hillside surface gets only the tonemap+AO+detail-normal-equivalent treatment, which is thinner than photoreal-drone's per-material atlas centerpiece. So the dramatic transformation is concentrated in the river draw and the forests, and a frame looking at bare scree/rock slopes (much of the Korengal) will be less transformed. (2) The post chain (tonemap + bloom + AO) is flagged as the riskiest COST item and shares the RGBA16F-vs-8bit-banding risk with the cinematic proposal; bloom is correctly the first cut but the water glint 'glow' is part of the marquee and degrades to plain specular without it. The wind-sway-on-canopy motion (technique 5) is a real differentiator but risks 'seasick' at close zoom — the amplitude cap is right but it is taste-fragile in stills (a screenshot can't show motion, so the matrix tool under-tests the very thing that makes this proposal special).
mustFix: Beef up the BULK-SLOPE surface (scree/rock/cropland) with real per-material micro-normals so the dominant pixels transform too — graft photoreal-drone's material atlas onto this water/motion spine, or the transformation reads as 'beautiful river + flat slopes.'

Because the marquee is MOTION and the screenshot matrix cannot capture it, add a short video/GIF capture to the verification harness (or a 3-frame strip showing flow advance) — otherwise the riskiest, most-differentiating claim ships unverified by the standing gate.

Pin the foam to genuinely-broken water (ford/steep-channel/rock) with hard caps so it can never wash the map, and verify fords read MORE legibly at operational+tactical — the legibility win is the proposal's best argument and must be proven, not asserted.

perProposal.strengths: Correctly identifies the single biggest 'icons-on-a-map' tell that the three terrain proposals largely ignore: the 164 flat SVG decals, the dotted-ring HESCO (confirmed in the COP close reference — it reads as a string of identical segments), and flat-sticker buildings/vehicles. The deferred-lit-sprite idea (technique 2) — one instanced WebGL2 pass lighting every sprite from the SAME SkyState the terrain reads, so a tower catches gold on its NW eave and the whole frame moves as ONE coherent lit world — is the right architectural instinct and is the one thing the other three proposals leave on the table. The HESCO-as-continuous-extruded-berm (technique 4) is a real, high-payoff, cheap win driven from the cop layout geometry the renderer already reads. The world-axis normal-rotation fix for rotating sprites (the exact bug the recovered art-director judge flagged at draw.ts:404/445) is a genuine latent-bug catch. The 2D-fallback parity (technique 14) and strategic-band detailGain crossfade (technique 13) are disciplined legibility guards.
perProposal.fatalFlaws: This is the proposal most at risk of being parity-plus-a-filter in disguise, just aimed at sprites instead of terrain. (1) FATAL FOUNDATION RISK, self-admitted as the riskiest bet: the entire cheap-volume promise rests on an OFFLINE GBuffer bake (SDF-extrude-from-silhouette) producing convincing normals for 164 assets without 164 hours of hand-art — and SDF-extrude notoriously yields mushy 'puffed-pillow' lighting. If it does, the only good-looking things are ~20 hand-authored heroes and the rest stay nearly flat, which is exactly the 'parity plus per-sprite drop-shadow' outcome the brief reverted. (2) ARCHITECTURAL CONTRADICTION WITH THE LOCKED ART: the 164 SVGs are authored per ART_BIBLE §1 with BAKED NW directional light + SE cast shadows. Live-relighting them either double-lights (baked SE shadow + live sun) or requires STRIPPING the baked light from all 164 sources — a massive re-author the proposal underweights (it mentions height layers only for ~20 heroes, but the albedo channel still carries baked shading for the long tail). (3) The terrain techniques here (9-12) are a thinner restatement of what photoreal-drone and living-valley do better — material LUT, animated water, canopy — so this proposal spreads effort across two fronts and goes deepest on the one (assets) with the weakest cost/benefit on a top-down map where most sprites are sub-pixel at the bands where the read matters most. At operational zoom a soldier is <8px and the lit detail is invisible (the proposal admits this); the asset lighting only pays off at tactical/close, a narrow band.
mustFix: De-risk the GBuffer bake FIRST as a spike: run SDF-extrude on the 10 highest-instance assets and screenshot-review BEFORE committing the architecture — if it reads as puffed-pillow, the whole cheap-volume thesis collapses and only the hand-authored heroes survive (which is not 10x).

Resolve the baked-light contradiction explicitly: either strip baked NW-key + SE shadow from ALL 164 albedo sources (huge, name the cost) or accept that the long tail double-lights — the ART_BIBLE §1 baked-directional-light convention and live-sun relight are mutually exclusive and the proposal cannot have both.

Drop the redundant terrain techniques (9-12) and either fold this proposal in as a GRAFT onto a terrain spine OR commit fully to assets — splitting effort across both fronts guarantees neither reaches 10x; the asset work should ride a terrain proposal's SkyState bus, not re-derive materials/water/canopy.

bestGrafts: photoreal-drone's per-landcover PBR material atlas + DETAIL-NORMAL RAKING is the single highest-leverage technique in the entire corpus — it is the one thing that converts a top-down painted surface into a photographed one, and it is the exact thing attempt-1 had ZERO of (its only 'detail' was a brightness-multiply grain at shaders.ts:182). This must be the centerpiece of whatever ships. Graft it onto ANY spine.

photoreal-drone's baked horizon-angle HBAO field (reuse the proven exponential-stride shadow march, omnidirectional + sun-independent, baked once at load) — replaces the fake `sky=0.5+0.5*n.z` ambient-occlusion term (shaders.ts:146) with real contact darkening at cliff bases / draw bottoms / terrace insides. Cheap (one-time bake), high payoff, format-safe.

living-valley's whitewater foam at fords (advected, capped, gated to genuinely-broken water) — the ONLY effect across all four proposals that simultaneously raises beauty AND legibility (it makes the SOP crossing more obvious). This is the gold-standard graft because it serves both masters at once.

living-valley's flow-advected river water (baked RG8 flow field from the centerX gradient, two-octave Vlachos flowmap, clock-keyed so pause stills it) is the best WATER design of the three that propose water — more grounded than the others' generic scrolling-normal water because the flow direction is derived from the actual channel geometry the sim already stores.

cinematic-film's god-ray technique 5a ONLY (in-fog shafts: in-scatter spiking along lit columns sampled from the cast-shadow map per raymarch step) — geometrically honest, uses the proven shadow map, and is the one genuinely-new IMAGE in the corpus. Take 5a, leave the screen-space 5b (the faked-sun-anchor lens-flare gimmick).

living-valley's weather-as-ground-state accumulators (wetness + snow integrated off the sim clock, persisted in BOTH serialize() and loadWorld()) — the only proposal that makes the valley remember its weather, and it correctly honors the new-persisted-state invariant.

asset-fidelity's HESCO-as-continuous-extruded-berm (one instanced strip driven from the cop layout geometry the renderer already reads) — a cheap, high-payoff fix to the dotted-ring tell visible in the COP reference, independent of the risky GBuffer bake.

asset-fidelity's world-axis normal-rotation discipline for rotating sprites (rotate n.xy by sprite rot in the fragment) — catches the latent draw.ts:404/445 baked-SE-on-rotated-statics bug the recovered art-director judge already flagged; correct even if the full deferred-sprite pass is dropped.
legibilityTraps: The NOON INVERSION trap is shared by all four and is the deepest. The sun is due-south on a north-up map at midday → near-flat, shadowless relief (the classic cartographic inversion condition the recovered art-director judge flagged). Every proposal keeps the `u_formLightNW` guard (shaders.ts:142), but detail-normals, god-rays, and aerial-perspective all auto-WEAKEN at noon exactly when the form-light read is most fragile. The trap: a proposal whose entire transformation is dawn/dusk-gated reverts toward 'attempt-1 with a tonemap' at midday. The noon-close and noon-tactical matrix frames are the make-or-break legibility gate, not dawn.

DETAIL-NORMALS FIGHTING MACRO RELIEF: photoreal-drone and the others all add micro-normals that, if too strong, read as NOISE over the macro form and destroy the terrain-shape read the player commands by (LOS, draws, ridgelines). Mitigation exists (per-material strength caps, ppm-gating) but it is taste-fragile and must be verified at operational zoom (where shape dominates) in a still, not just close zoom.

MOTION CANNOT BE SCREENSHOT-TESTED: living-valley's marquee (flowing water, wind sway, the pause-freeze) is invisible to the recovered visual-matrix.mjs still-frame harness. The standing legibility/verification gate structurally under-tests the very thing that proposal stakes its 10x on. Any motion-heavy proposal needs a video/GIF capture added to the gate or it ships its riskiest claim unverified.

CLOUD-SHADOW / FOG-PATCH MIS-READING AS RELIEF in stills/pause: the recovered art-director judge already flagged a 0.34-dense cloud shadow lying across a spur reads as a reentrant. Cinematic-film's heavier raymarched fog and god-rays amplify this — a fog column or shaft in a paused frame can be mistaken for terrain, breaking the read the moment the player pauses to study the ground.

SPECULAR WATER GLINT STROBING / over-brightness over the river crossing: all three water proposals risk a noon glint blowing out the tactical read at the exact ford the player must cross. The ortho fixed-view-vector also means the glint has no parallax sparkle and can look static or strobe under SwiftShader low precision. Caps + clock-keyed continuous normals are the fix but must be proven in the matrix.

ASSET LIGHTING IS INVISIBLE WHERE IT MATTERS: asset-fidelity's per-sprite lighting only resolves at tactical/close (>1.2 ppm); at operational a soldier is <8px and the lit detail is sub-pixel — so the effort buys nothing at the band where the player most needs to read unit positions, and risks adding visual noise to the symbol-crossfade.

BLOOM VEILING: every proposal adds bloom; if the threshold is too low it veils mid-tones and the tactical read. All correctly note the HUD/units are on the separate 2D canvas (immune by construction) — that architectural firewall is the real guarantee and must be preserved; bloom must stay highlight-only (luma>~1.0 knee) and pre-tonemap.
feasibilityTraps: RGBA16F RENDERABILITY UNDER SWIFTSHADER IS UNPROVEN. The recovered, proven stack uses NO float color attachment (RGBA8 main, R8 shadow, R32F-NEAREST height, OES_texture_float_linear for the float SAMPLERS only). cinematic-film and living-valley both stake their HDR foundation / bloom on RGBA16F being renderable in the headless --disable-gpu harness. Both flag it with an RGBA8 packed-exposure fallback, but a miss quietly guts the 'highlights breathe / snow blooms' marquee. This MUST be probed in Phase 0 against the actual harness, not assumed. (photoreal-drone correctly sidesteps this by tonemapping in the existing pass with no float target — a real feasibility advantage.)

PER-FRAME COST ON SWIFTSHADER IS THE HARD GATE, not iGPU. The existing baseline is ~8.3M frags × ~14 cache-hit texelFetches (honest 2-4ms on Iris Xe; far slower on software SwiftShader). photoreal-drone stacks 2-3 atlas taps + 1-2 normal taps; cinematic-film stacks a 6-8 step fog raymarch (each step samples height + cast-shadow); living-valley adds a masked water pass + post chain. The screenshot harness runs on SwiftShader and is the binding cost constraint — every proposal's close-zoom budget claim needs harness verification BEFORE the heavy phase ships, with the cheaper fallback pre-implemented behind a flag (not merely described).

ASSET-FIDELITY'S GBUFFER BAKE IS THE SINGLE BIGGEST FEASIBILITY TRAP. SDF-extrude-from-silhouette producing convincing normals for 164 assets is unproven and notoriously yields 'puffed-pillow' mush; the asset-manifest pipeline currently only bundles raw SVG strings (confirmed in build-asset-manifest.mjs) so the entire GBuffer/normal/AO/material bake is NEW infrastructure. If the bake disappoints, only ~20 hand-heroes look good — the parity outcome the brief reverted. Must be de-risked as a spike on 10 assets first.

ASSET-FIDELITY'S BAKED-LIGHT CONTRADICTION: the 164 SVGs carry baked NW-key directional light + SE cast shadows per ART_BIBLE §1 (a hard authoring requirement — assets are rejected without a contact shadow). Live-relighting them double-lights unless the baked light is STRIPPED from all 164 albedo sources — a re-author the proposal underweights. The recovered synthesis even amended ART_BIBLE §1 ('terrain is live-sun-lit; NW key superseded for terrain') but that amendment was for TERRAIN, not the sprite albedo, which still bakes directional light.

DETERMINISM / SERIALIZE INVARIANT: living-valley's wetness + snow accumulators are new persisted floats that MUST go in BOTH serialize() AND loadWorld() (a named project invariant) or a same-seed reload diverges — the smoke.ts round-trip gate will catch it but it is easy to half-implement. photoreal-drone's surfaceState texture as a pure function of (clock, weather, seed) is the cleaner determinism story (rebakeable, not necessarily persisted).

THE SHADOW MARCH IS PROVEN — DO NOT RE-DERIVE IT. The recovered judge arithmetically REFUTED the 480m fixed march (a 780m ridge at 20° throws ~2.1km of shadow); only the 56-step exponential stride (5·1.13^k) reaches it. All four proposals correctly reuse SHADOW_FRAG verbatim — that is the right call and a refuted-negative that must be honored; any proposal that quietly re-rolls its own march math is repeating a known failure.

CHUNK-SPLICE / SINGLE-WRITER COORDINATION: attempt-1's synthesis found the terrain core's 'reserved 1-tap hook' was insufficient and had to adopt a chunk-splice GLSL assembly with a documented locals contract (worldM/elev/altNorm/N/sunVis/direct/ambient/albedo/cliff) and a pinned combine order. Whichever spine ships must define that insertion-point contract up front or the material/water/atmosphere additions will each try to reopen the core shader — the exact integration failure the recovered judge called out.
verdicts.recommendedSpine: "SPINE: photoreal-drone, nearly whole. It is the only proposal whose central diagnosis is exactly right — on a top-down ortho camera with no parallax or silhouette, the photographed-vs-painted read MUST be carried by light acting on real per-material micro-normals, and detail-normal raking under the live low sun is the precise thing attempt-1 had zero of. It demotes the albedo bake from 'the image' to one of five inputs (the literal inverse of `col=albedo*(0.34+0.95*shade)`), it replaces the fake `0.5+0.5*n.z` AO with a real HBAO bake reusing the proven shadow march, and — decisively for shippability — it tonemaps in the existing pass with NO RGBA16F dependency, sidestepping the one unproven foundational assumption (SwiftShader float-color renderability) that the two cinematic proposals stake their marquee on. Its phase plan is also the best: Phase 1 (linear lighting, numeric noon-luma calibration, no new textures) ships a strict improvement before any risk lands, and Phases 1+3 alone clear the bar, so the 10x is not all-or-nothing on the riskiest technique. GRAFT onto this spine: (1) living-valley's flow-advected river + whitewater foam at fords — the foam is the rare both-masters win (beauty AND legibility) and the river is a thin slice of pixels so the cost is cheap and contained; this answers photoreal-drone's own water technique with a better, channel-geometry-driven design. (2) living-valley's weather-as-ground-state accumulators if persistence is wanted (honor the serialize/loadWorld invariant). (3) cinematic-film's god-ray technique 5a ONLY (in-fog shafts from the cast-shadow map) as the one genuinely-new dawn IMAGE — leave the screen-space 5b gimmick. (4) asset-fidelity's HESCO-continuous-berm and world-axis sprite-normal-rotation fix as cheap, isolated grafts — but do NOT take its deferred-sprite/GBuffer architecture as a primary axis: the SDF-extrude bake is the corpus's biggest unproven feasibility trap and contradicts the baked-light ART_BIBLE convention. CUTS: cinematic-film's RGBA16F-dependent HDR foundation (use photoreal-drone's in-pass tonemap), the screen-space god-rays (5b), and asset-fidelity's full GBuffer relight pipeline (reduce to the two grafts above; sprite fidelity is a separate later campaign, not this terrain spine). The one non-negotiable verification: the NOON close + tactical matrix frames are the make-or-break gate, because every proposal's transformation auto-weakens at midday and that is precisely where a dawn-gated proposal silently reverts to 'attempt-1 with a tonemap.'"

contract.spine:
SPINE = photoreal-drone (surface RECOMPOSITION), with grafts. Unanimous across all four judge verdicts (8.5/8.5/7.5/9). The governing inversion of attempt-1: the albedo bake is DEMOTED from "the image" to ONE input of five — the fragment recomposes the surface per-fragment from the sim's own arrays. Everything reuses the proven skeleton; nothing redoes it.

REUSE VERBATIM (do not touch the math): (1) lib/render/sky.ts — the verified solar model, SkyState, grade block, weather single-fold rule, spriteShadow. Extend LIGHT_KEYS/GRADE_KEYS tables only if richer color is wanted; keep geometry + contracts. (2) PRELUDE in gl/shaders.ts — bit-faithful heightAt (= Terrain.elevAt, NEAREST 512² R32F + manual 4-tap bilinear) and normalAt (forward-difference). This is the contour-registration contract; never re-derive it. (3) SHADOW_FRAG — the 56-step exponential-stride (5m·1.13^k) sun-visibility march into a 1024² R8 FBO, rebaked only on key-dir motion (>0.25°, 200ms rate-limit). The 480m fixed march was arithmetically REFUTED; do not re-roll it. (4) TerrainGL two-canvas integration — opaque WebGL2 under transparent Canvas-2D, DPR+shake sync, worldToScreen-inverse vertex, OES_texture_float_linear probe, context-loss handlers, alive 2D fallback at the `ok` branch. (5) atmosphere-model.ts floor-field fog (128² local-valley-floor min-field, diurnalFog ramp, advanceCloud integrator, fogVisAt parity).

PIPELINE ORDER (the master tick already drives this via store.frame → SkyState/AtmoState uniforms; render is PURE w.r.t. clock/weather/seed): per terrain load — CPU worker bakes [flat-linear albedo atlas-blend-ready landColor bake | u_landId R8UI | u_control RGBA8 (slope, conceal, cover, free) | flow-field RG8 + river-mask R8 | local-floor 128² | HBAO 512² R8 via the omnidirectional shadow-march]. Per sun-motion — rebake the R8 sun-visibility map (existing throttle). Per frame — PASS A: render terrain+water into an RGBA16F HDR target (probe-and-branch to RGBA8-direct; RGBA16F VERIFIED renderable on --use-angle=swiftshader, see cuts) doing in LINEAR space: surface recomposition (atlas albedo demoted to one input) → detail-normal raking → physical lighting (sun·shadow + hemisphere·HBAO + moon) → specular water → snow/wetness surface-state → single-scatter aerial perspective → in-fog god-ray in-scatter. PASS B (HDR-only, GL canvas only): half-res bright-pass (luma>1.0 knee) + 2-tap separable bloom. PASS C: composite bloom, ACES (Narkowicz) tonemap, sky.grade WB/sat/lift, Bayer dither → sRGB to the visible canvas. The 2D canvas (contours/units/reticles/HUD) sits ABOVE, ungraded, untouched — the legibility firewall is architectural.

MATERIAL/LIGHTING MODEL (one spec): all lighting in LINEAR radiance (atlas albedos de-gamma'd once on bake). L = albedo·(sunColor·sunI·NdotL·shadowVis·cloudVis·sunUp + hemisphere·HBAO + moonColor·moonFactor·NdotMoon·moonVis) + specular(roughness). hemisphere = mix(groundColor, skyColor, 0.5+0.5·N.z)·skyI·HBAO (HBAO multiplies AMBIENT only, never direct). N = perturb(macroNormal, detailNormal·detailStrength) where detailStrength = perMaterial · clamp((ppm-0.5)/1.5) · (sun rake-angle factor). The formLightNW noon guard (max(keySun,keyNW) blended at 0.32, shaders.ts:138-142) is kept verbatim AND the detail-normal micro-light is slaved to the SAME key direction the guard picks at noon (resolves the noon micro/macro-disagreement trap). Then aerial perspective, then HDR bloom/ACES/grade. Single audited u_detailGain uniform (ppm-gated, →0 at strategic) multiplies EVERY added high-frequency effect (detail-normals, atlas 2nd octave, specular, bloom, procedural canopy/furrow) so strategic collapses to the byte-faithful relief+albedo of today, calibrated to attempt-1's noon-clear mid-gray luma as a NUMERIC gate.

GRAFTS onto the spine: living-valley's flow-advected river (RG8 flow field from centerXAt gradient + R8 bank-distance mask, two-octave Vlachos flowmap) + whitewater foam-at-fords (the rare both-masters effect — beauty AND crossing legibility) is the WATER marquee, preferred over photoreal's own specular-water section. cinematic-film's in-fog god-rays (technique 5a ONLY — in-scatter spiking along lit columns sampled from the existing R8 shadow map) + single-scatter aerial perspective (vertical-column extinction keyed to the SACRED visibilityM) are the ATMOSPHERE grafts. asset-fidelity's instanced deferred sprite pass (world-frame normal rotation) + continuous-HESCO-berm + contact-AO grounding is a SEPARATE LATER asset campaign after the terrain spine ships (so the resolving ground does not out-resolve flat-sticker buildings).

subsystems.name: data-spine (material-ID + control + surface-state textures)
subsystems.spec: Three uploads beside the existing 512² R32F height, all NEAREST/texelFetch, ~0.8MB total, baked in the existing terrain worker. (a) u_landId: 512² R8UI via gl.texImage2D(R8UI, RED_INTEGER, UNSIGNED_BYTE, terrain.land). Read with `precision highp usampler2D; texelFetch(u_landId, ivec2(w/cell), 0).r`. PROBED CLEAN on --use-angle=swiftshader (R8UI 512² upload = 0 GL errors, usampler2D+texelFetch compiles/links). Dissolve the 5m stairstep at class edges with a 2x2 jittered-nearest sample (port topo.ts dither into GLSL). (b) u_control: 512² RGBA8 LINEAR packing R=slope/2 clamped, G=conceal (canopy density, terrain.conceal), B=cover (terrain.cover), A=free. (c) u_surfaceState: 256² RGBA8 LINEAR, R=snowDepth, G=wetness, B=trackDust, A=spare — CPU rebakes on weather/clock change. This is the render↔sim contract: render READS terrain arrays, never writes. UNIT TEST (mirrors heightAt parity): texelFetch(u_landId,cell)==terrain.land[i] for 64 sample cells, asserted in a scratch harness. Land→material-group LUT is a const int[26] in-shader mapping the 26-class enum to ~12 material slots.
sourceProposals: photoreal-drone: Material-ID + control textures (the data spine)
subsystems.cost: upload 1-2ms on terrain load only; per-frame sampling folds into the material pass. SwiftShader: negligible (NEAREST texelFetch).

subsystems.name: terrain-materials (per-landcover PBR atlas + detail-normal raking)
subsystems.spec: THE centerpiece — the single highest-payoff-per-ms technique in the whole corpus (judge-unanimous). One 1024² RGBA8 albedo atlas + one RG8 detail-normal atlas (z reconstructed) + roughness packed in albedo.a, authored as ~12 tiles for the material GROUPS (rock/scree, grass/scrub, forest/orchard canopy, cropland/terrace furrow, riverbed gravel, mud/compound, hesco, snow, gravel, dry-wash). GENERATED DETERMINISTICALLY in the CPU worker at load from FBM+worley (reuse topo.ts hash2/vnoise/fbm2 verbatim for seed-faithful noise) — NO shipped PNGs, so the seed contract holds and there is no asset pipeline. COMMIT to the CPU-worker bake path (not offscreen GLSL) and assert a hash of the generated atlas in smoke.ts (the atlas is now part of the seed contract). Sample at WORLD scale: uv = v_world/tileMeters (tileMeters≈8m, 2nd octave at 2m mixed by ppm·u_detailGain so the tile never visibly repeats). Manual per-tile atlas addressing: clamp UV inside each padded tile gutter (NO hardware wrap across tiles) to kill seam bleed — this is the named shipping-bug; pad 4px gutters + clamp in shader math. Blend two neighboring materials across the jittered land edge. ALBEDO base is seeded from the SAME landColor() palette (topo.ts:23) byte-for-byte at strategic, so the atlas only ADDS high-frequency detail that fades in with u_detailGain — the strategic read is provably unchanged. Detail-normal raking: perturb macro normalAt by the atlas RG normal in a cheap world-up TBN (tangent +x, bitangent +y), rotated by the macro slope: n = normalize(macroN + detailStrength·vec3(dN.xy,0)). detailStrength = perMaterial(scree high, cropland furrows directional-along-contour, water excluded) · u_detailGain · (1 - sunFlatness). NOON RULE: as the sun flattens, detailStrength →0 AND the residual micro-light is driven from the SAME faked-NW key the formLightNW guard uses (so micro and macro shading never disagree). Cropland furrow amplitude capped + forbidden from aligning tightly with contours (so a furrow is not misread as a defilade/wall). FALLBACK behind a compile flag (pre-implemented, not described): single-channel detail-HEIGHT tap → derivative normals (1 tap), if the close-band SwiftShader budget is blown.
sourceProposals: living-valley: procedural canopy material (graft the conceal-driven canopy lobe into the forest/orchard material slot)
subsystems.cost: 3-6ms on SwiftShader at CLOSE band (2-3 atlas taps + 1-2 normal taps) — MUST be measured at close band before Phase 3 is called done; folds to <1ms at operational/strategic via u_detailGain. iGPU <1ms.

subsystems.name: lighting (physical sun+sky+moon, linear space)
subsystems.spec: Replaces the scalar `0.34+0.95·shade` hack. Work in LINEAR radiance. L = albedo·(sunColor·sunI·NdotL·vis·cloudVis·sunUp + hemisphere + moonColor·moonFactor·NdotMoon·moonVis·moonUp) + spec. hemisphere = mix(groundColor, skyColor, 0.5+0.5·n.z)·skyI·HBAO. All driven VERBATIM by SkyState uniforms (sunDir/sunColor/sunIntensity/skyColor/groundColor/skyIntensity/moonDir/moonColor/moonFactor) already wired in terrain-gl.ts. Keep the formLightNW guard (max(keySun,keyNW)·0.32) as the noon anti-inversion guard ONLY. Clamp the hemisphere/ambient floor so shadowed faces never drop below ~0.45× lit luma (sky.ts shadowStrength already specs this) — proven at dusk/night so ACES toe never crushes the tactical read below the legibility floor. CALIBRATION GATE: a one-time numeric pass matches mid-gray luma at noon-clear to attempt-1's recovered frame (a NUMBER, not a vibe), held across every later phase; relief must NOT invert at noon at any of the 4 bands.
sourceProposals: photoreal-drone: Physical sun+sky+moon lighting in linear space

subsystems.name: AO (baked horizon-angle HBAO)
subsystems.spec: Bake a 512² R8 AO field ONCE in the terrain worker (hidden behind the deploy loading bar): for each cell march the heightmap in 16 azimuths a few exponential steps each, AO = 1 - average(sin(maxHorizonAngle)). REUSES the exact exponential-stride march already written for SHADOW_FRAG, just omnidirectional + sun-independent. Judge arithmetic VERIFIED: 512²×16 azimuths ≈ 1.3e8 heightAt fetches ≈ 0.6× of ONE existing 1024² shadow rebake — a real, near-free load cost. Sampled LINEAR in the main pass, multiplies the AMBIENT term ONLY (never direct), so shadows+AO compound correctly. This is the ONE added effect that makes terrain MORE legible — contact darkening in draw bottoms, cliff bases, terrace insides, building footprints, where the dead ground is. Replaces the fake `0.5+0.5·n.z` AO term.
subsystems.cost: bake ~40-80ms once on load; per-frame = one texture tap. Zero risk.

subsystems.name: cast-shadows (penumbra refine)
subsystems.spec: Keep SHADOW_FRAG's 56-step march + the rebake-on-sun-motion FBO VERBATIM (the multi-km dawn ridge shadow is the marquee macro element). Refine ONLY the output: widen the final smoothstep penumbra ∝ distance-to-occluder (a far ridge casts a soft edge, a near boulder a sharp one), 3-tap PCF on the R8 vis map scaled by ppm in the main pass. Determinism preserved (output is sun-angle-determined; the wall-clock rate-limiter only throttles).
sourceProposals: photoreal-drone: Refined cast-shadow penumbra + contact hardening
subsystems.cost: rebake unchanged (few Hz, not per-frame); 3-tap PCF in main pass ~0.3ms.

subsystems.name: water (flow-advected river + ford foam)
subsystems.spec: WATER marquee. CPU-bake once (deterministic, cached on Terrain): a 512² RG8 flow field = unit downstream direction per river cell derived from d(centerXAt(y))/dy + channel gradient, plus an R8 river mask (0 dry, distance-to-bank ramp for shoreline). Gate the water branch by texelFetch(u_landId) ∈ {River=0, Marsh=1, Ford=25, Footbridge=20-adjacent} — early-out keeps cost to ~2-4% of pixels. Sample TWO scrolling octaves of a tiling curl-of-noise normal map offset by flowDir·(world.secondsOfDay·speed) at two scales/phases, blend Vlachos-style (no visible tiling/pulse). Build water normal; fresnel = pow(1-dot(N,up),5) → mix(depthTintedBody, skyColor, fresnel) where body lerps shallow gravel-teal→deep slate by bank distance; Blinn/GGX sun-tracked glint toward sky.sunDir (the dawn glint, exceeds 1.0 → feeds bloom). FOAM: intensity = max(slopeBreak along channel, fordMask dilated 1 cell, rockProximity); animate with a sawtooth birth→fade phase scrolled along the flow field (advection illusion); composite additive near-#f3ecd6 (never pure white, ART_BIBLE). Foam is the rare both-masters effect — it makes the SOP crossing MORE obvious. ALL phase keyed to world.secondsOfDay (freezes on pause, time-warp speeds the current; NO wall clock). HARD-CLAMP glint+foam so no bright highlight ever lands washing a route/ford read; ortho fixed-view-vector means the glint shimmers via the animated normal field, not parallax.
sourceProposals: living-valley: River sun-glint sparkle & shoreline wet-darkening
photoreal-drone: Real specular water (glint/fresnel math reference)
subsystems.cost: ~1.0-1.8ms on SwiftShader but masked early-out to river fragments; iGPU <0.3ms. Two 8-bit textures cache-resident.

subsystems.name: atmosphere-fog (single-scatter aerial perspective + in-fog god-rays)
subsystems.spec: Replaces attempt-1's flat altitude-haze mix() and upgrades the floor-field fog to light transport. AERIAL PERSPECTIVE (folds into relief pass, ~0.3ms): orthographic vertical-column approximation — opticalDepth = exp(-(fragElev-minElev)/H_scale)·columnLen (H_scale≈600m); transmittance=exp(-beta·opticalDepth); inscatter = mix(skyColor, sunColor, forwardScatterLobe(sunDir.z))·(1-transmittance); col = col·transmittance + inscatter. beta keyed to the SACRED visibilityM (600-4000 → extinction) so it can NEVER exceed what weather declares. VALLEY FOG: reuse the 128² local-floor min-field; fog top = localFloor + diurnalFog(hour) + weather fogBoost (atmosphere-model.ts verbatim). Upgrade from mix() to a SHORT 4-8 step raymarch (step count LOD'd: 2 strategic → 6-8 close, hard early-out `if(fragElev>fogTop) skip`) accumulating Beer-Lambert transmittance + per-step in-scatter = density·(sunColor·sunI·sampleCastShadow(p) + skyColor·skyI). IN-FOG GOD-RAYS (technique 5a ONLY): the per-step cast-shadow sample makes in-scatter SPIKE along lit columns and stay dark under the ridge — geometrically TRUE shafts from the existing resident R8 shadow map, near-free, no extra pass. COMPOUND-VEIL FLOOR GATE (non-negotiable): aerial-perspective inscatter + fog inscatter + bloom must SUM below a numeric luma floor measured against the recovered fog-dawn-operational.png in the river draw — one combined gate, not three independent caps. Single-fold weather rule preserved (exposure carries weatherLightMult once).
sourceProposals: cinematic-film: Raymarched valley fog volume with in-scatter
cinematic-film: Volumetric god-rays (technique 5a in-fog only — 5b CUT)
subsystems.cost: aerial ~0.3ms; fog raymarch ~0.9ms WHEN fog present (early-out = 0ms clear days). The dawn-fog frame is the worst case — must be in the summed worst-frame budget.

subsystems.name: post-tonemap-bloom (HDR + ACES + bloom + dither)
subsystems.spec: PROBE-AND-BRANCH at init: RGBA16F render target is VERIFIED renderable on --use-angle=swiftshader (rgba16f_renderable=true, EXT_color_buffer_float=true, OES_texture_float_linear=true, confirmed by /tmp probe this session) — so the DEFAULT path is a real half-float HDR intermediate. Keep an RGBA8 packed-exposure fallback at the same branch as the 2D fallback (only triggers if a future driver lacks it; --disable-gpu alone returns NOGL → 2D fallback). PASS B bloom: bright-pass (luma>1.0 soft knee) into a half-res RGBA16F, separable Gaussian (2 passes × ~9 taps at half then quarter res), add back BEFORE tonemap so ACES rolls the bloomed highlights naturally. Bloom is GL-canvas only (HUD/units on the 2D layer are immune by construction) and threshold-high so only true highlights (dawn glint, snow crest) bloom — verify the strategic relief read survives bloom at golden hour. PASS C: ACES-fitted Narkowicz tonemap ((x·(2.51x+0.03))/(x·(2.43x+0.59)+0.14)), then sky.grade WB·exposure·sat·lift (reuse the existing grade() GLSL verbatim, exposure single-folded), then ordered Bayer 8×8 dither to kill 8-bit banding in sky-ambient gradients, then linear→sRGB. NO chromatic aberration, NO vignette above operational (cut — they degrade the corner terrain read). Bloom is the FIRST thing gated off under a measured frame-budget trigger.
sourceProposals: photoreal-drone: ACES filmic tonemap + threshold bloom + dither
living-valley: Filmic tonemap + bloom + AO post
subsystems.cost: tonemap+dither ~0.2ms; bloom ~2-3ms on SwiftShader (1 half-res bright-pass + 2 blur passes). Bloom is the budget-cut candidate.

subsystems.name: surface-state (snow accumulation/melt + wet-ground + track dust)
subsystems.spec: Physical surface state integrated from clock+weather into u_surfaceState (256² RGBA8). SNOW (R): coverage = smoothstep(snowLine, +band, elev)·(1-slope·k)·aspectBias(pole-facing n.y<0)·(1-conceal·0.6); snowDepth ACCUMULATES over game-hours under weather.Snow and MELTS on warm/low ground — slow campaign-scale, never a strobe. CRITICAL legibility cap: snow albedo on skyline/LOS-relevant ridge cells is capped below a threshold that would wash the crest silhouette the player ranges off, and the cold-ambient bounce must NEVER raise a shadowed crest face above its lit face (no relief inversion). WET (G): after Rain, albedo·=mix(1,0.7,wet), roughness·=(1-0.6·wet) (broad low-sun sheen), wetness pools toward low ground (reuse localFloor) and dries over hours; HARD-clamp the wet spec so no sheen washes a road/trail at any sun angle, gated by sunIntensity (self-limits under overcast when it is actually wet). DUST (B): Road/Track fragments lighten/desaturate in dry spells. DETERMINISM: u_surfaceState is a PURE function of (clock, weather, seed) recomputed on load — the clean determinism story (no new persisted floats needed). IF persisted for save-resume, the snow/wetness accumulators MUST land in BOTH serialize() AND loadWorld() with a smoke.ts round-trip assert (the named invariant). Default: recompute, do not persist.
sourceProposals: living-valley: Wetness accumulator + snow accumulation (framing/melt logic)
subsystems.cost: ~0.6ms total (mix + atlas tap shared with material pass).

subsystems.name: cloud-shadows (drift + soft penumbra)
subsystems.spec: Reuse atmoState cloudOffset (integrated from windVector by advanceCloud, clock-driven, freezes on pause — proven in attempt-1). Upgrade the procedural fbm2 cloud term to 3-octave for ragged edges + a low-freq coverage layer; penumbra smoothstep widens with assumed cloud altitude. Dims the DIRECT sun beam ONLY (never ambient) so shadowed ground stays lit by the hemisphere floor (legible). Per-weather density/strength already tabled in WX_ATMO. WARNING (legibility): a dense cloud shadow lying across a spur can read as a reentrant in a paused still — keep cloudStrength capped and the edge soft.
sourceProposals: cinematic-film: Drifting cloud shadows with soft penumbra

subsystems.name: asset-relight (LATER, SEPARATE phase — deferred-lit sprites + HESCO berm)
subsystems.spec: DEFERRED to a separate asset campaign AFTER the terrain spine ships — but scoped now so the close band is not a resolving ground under flat-sticker buildings. Instanced WebGL2 deferred sprite pass lighting ALL world-dressing sprites in ONE draw (strictly cheaper than today's 164 CPU drawImage blits) from the SAME SkyState + the SAME formLightNW guard the terrain uses. LOAD-BEARING CORRECTNESS: rotate the tangent-space normal into WORLD frame in the fragment AFTER the sprite's heading rotation (rotate n.xy by rot) — else rotating soldiers/vehicles get lighting that spins with heading (the bug the art-director judge flagged at draw.ts:404/445). VERIFY with a 360° turntable probe of one soldier. HESCO: re-author the dotted-segment ring as ONE continuous extruded berm (instanced strip driven from cop layout geometry) with mitered corners + sandbag parapet + gate cut — highest single-asset payoff for ~0.2ms. CONTACT-AO: dark soft halo where any raised object meets the ground (seats objects IN the dirt). RESOLVE the ART_BIBLE §1 baked-NW-light contradiction explicitly: either strip baked directional light from the 164 SVG albedo sources, or accept the long tail double-lights — these are mutually exclusive. DE-RISK the SDF-extrude bake on 3-4 long-tail assets BEFORE committing the GBuffer pipeline (the 'puffed-pillow' failure mode); if mushy, hand-author only the high-pixel heroes (HESCO, B-hut, tower, MRAP, qalat, soldier, cedar) + lean on cast-shadow+contact-AO for the tail. 2D-fallback parity: the albedo channel IS the old flat sprite, single `ok` branch mirrors TerrainGL.ok.

cuts: cinematic-film's SCREEN-SPACE god-ray pass (technique 5b): faked off-screen sun-anchor + 24-32-tap radial blur for a sun geometrically below the horizon. CUT — it is a lens-flare tell that fights the sober-ISR bar, fans bright streaks across the tactical center, and is an extra fullscreen pass on the fill-rate-bound SwiftShader rasterizer. KEEP only 5a (in-fog shafts from the existing R8 shadow map): geometrically true, near-free, no extra pass. (Refuted by all 4 judges; the proposer itself offered it as cuttable.)

cinematic-film's wholesale STRIP of all baked lighting/haze/altitude from topo.ts in the foundation phase. CUT — high blast radius that risks the byte-faithful strategic read attempt-1 already got right. Instead: demote the albedo bake to one input incrementally (the photoreal-drone approach); keep the strategic band byte-faithful and migrate lighting per-phase behind u_detailGain.

CUT — a screen-space gradient CANNOT rotate normals into world frame, so rotating soldiers/vehicles get heading-spun lighting (the exact bug). REPLACED by asset-fidelity's correct per-instance world-frame deferred sprite pass, in the later asset phase.

Chromatic aberration and vignette (cinematic-film film-finish). CUT — they degrade the corner terrain read where operational/strategic ground lives; grain over a relief map adds high-frequency noise mistakable for micro-relief. Keep only ACES + Bayer dither + grade in PASS C.

The RGBA8 packed-exposure HDR fallback as the DEFAULT path (feared by cinematic/living-valley/asset-fidelity). NOT the default — RGBA16F renderability was PROBED TRUE on the actual --use-angle=swiftshader harness this session (rgba16f_renderable=true, EXT_color_buffer_float=true, floatLinear=true). The half-float HDR target IS the default; the RGBA8 path stays only as the probe-and-branch contingency (and --disable-gpu-alone → NOGL → the existing alive 2D fallback). The judges' #1 stated feasibility fear is a non-issue on the target; the REAL constraint is CPU-rasterizer FILL-RATE.

Re-rolling the cast-shadow march math. CUT/FORBIDDEN — the 480m fixed march was arithmetically REFUTED (a 780m ridge at 20° throws ~2.1km; only the 56-step 5·1.13^k exponential stride reaches it). Reuse SHADOW_FRAG verbatim; this is a recorded negative.

asset-fidelity as the TERRAIN BACKBONE. CUT as the spine — it spends its best ideas on assets while its terrain section is a thinner bolted-on material LUT; making it the backbone would re-commit attempt-1's timidity on the ground (the exact axis the owner called out). It is the correct ASSET graft as a SEPARATE later campaign, not the terrain answer.

Canopy/grass WIND SWAY as a default-on tactical-zoom effect (living-valley). CUT to near-zero / gated OFF at operational+strategic — a subtly crawling map competes with units/fire for the eye and fights the sober-chart half of the bar.
